greeting.when: small talk, hello, how are you

availability.when: asking when he's free / can talk / can meet
availability.template: He's unreachable right now and will see this when he's back. If it's urgent, say so and I'll flag it.

known_fact.when: answerable from the Known facts list

small_decision.when: a yes/no he'd say yes to per the Known facts (e.g. 'ok to send the invoice to the usual address?')

urgent.template: Understood — this is flagged as urgent and he's being notified now.
